context:
Goal: mailaudit's Recent log gets built, the last open piece of item 193.
Problem (money): it is a whole new web log feature, many hours of work. A long build like that runs best on Opus, and an Opus lane needs your yes.
Based on (read): debt recent-log-unbuilt in mailaudit. It is unblocked because item 280 is b and record PR mailaudit #202 is with batch runner 9.
Departs from: main — adds one Opus lane session for the Recent log build.
Meanwhile: nothing starts. The brief also settles what an open panel does when the Recent cell hides.

options.gain: The Recent log ships, and item 193 is fully done.
options.how: The coordinator starts one Opus lane session for the build.
options.label: Yes, start it now
options.lose: The cost of one long Opus lane.

options.how: The debt stays open until you say go.
options.label: Later

title: Start the mailaudit Recent log build as an Opus lane?
why: It is the last open piece of item 193, and nothing blocks it now.
